data.name: Arcane Survival
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Arcane Survival

Step into a vibrant, beautifully stylized anime world powered by Unreal Engine 5.5. In this realm, magic is everything. You are a powerful sorcerer thrust into a relentless arena of mystical chaos. Whether fighting alone or standing side-by-side with your coven, you must harness raw elemental forces, craft unstoppable spell combinations, and obliterate screens full of mythical monsters.

Choose Your Magic

No two mages are the same. Select from a diverse roster of anime-styled heroes, each starting the match with a completely unique core magic power:

  • The Pyromancer: Ignite the battlefield with screen-clearing, explosive firestorms.

  • The Cryomancer: Freeze elite threats in their tracks and shatter hordes with icy spikes.

  • The Void Weaver: Manipulate space to pull enemies into lethal gravity wells.

  • The Storm Caller: Chain blinding bolts of lightning across dozens of targets at once.

Team Up or Die Alone

Bring your friends or find allies online! Arcane Survival fully supports up to 4-player online co-op multiplayer. Combine different magical elements with your teammates to trigger devastating elemental reactions. Coordinate your crowd control, shield your allies, and pool your powers to survive screens packed with hundreds of enemies.

Two Intense Game Modes

Adapt your strategy across two distinct, action-packed ways to play:

  • Survival Mode: A pure, fast-paced roguelike experience. Move constantly, collect magical essence, level up your traits, and outlast the ticking clock before a massive, screen-filling boss arrives.

  • Defense Mode: Anchor your position and protect a sacred magical nexus. Build a defensive strategy, manage incoming enemy lanes, and hold the line against increasingly brutal waves of attackers.

Next-Gen Arcane Visuals

Experience magic like never before. Built from the ground up in Unreal Engine 5.5, the game features cutting-edge, ultra-fluid anime VFX. Watch your spells light up the environment, see enemies explode into spectacular bursts of particle effects, and feel the raw impact of every spell cast without sacrificing fast-paced performance.
